note: Authored learning scenarios, not inferred emotions or observations of real people. Source and attendance links are computed from flow-demo.json.

support.zh: 表單可分段填寫，會議提供照顧支持
support.en: Allow pauses in the form and offer care support

positive.zh: 原話變成明確的過街改善條件
positive.en: The crossing concern becomes an explicit condition

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 讓陪同過街不再是一場趕時間的冒險。
motivation.en: Make assisted crossings safer without racing the clock.

incentive.zh: 能分段參與，也知道誰會處理照顧需求。
incentive.en: Join in short sessions and know who will address care needs.

desiredOutcome.zh: 把照顧者的停等時間寫進試辦條件。
desiredOutcome.en: Include caregivers’ waiting times in the pilot conditions.

stageActions.zh: 畫出陪同過街最吃力的位置。
stageActions.en: Map the hardest part of an assisted crossing.

stageActions.zh: 告知能參與的照顧空檔。
stageActions.en: Share available gaps between care duties.

stageActions.zh: 確認不同照顧需求都有代表。
stageActions.en: Check that different care needs are represented.

stageActions.zh: 比較號誌秒數與陪同行走速度。
stageActions.en: Compare signal timing with assisted walking speed.

stageActions.zh: 說明一次趕不及綠燈的經驗。
stageActions.en: Describe a crossing that outlasted the green light.

stageActions.zh: 協商停等空間與臨停例外。
stageActions.en: Negotiate waiting space and drop-off exceptions.

stageActions.zh: 確認照顧條件由誰負責落實。
stageActions.en: Check who owns the care-related conditions.

stageActions.zh: 帶著照顧紀錄回來檢查試辦。
stageActions.en: Return with care notes to review the pilot.

roundFocus.zh: 讓安全問題包含陪同行走的速度。
roundFocus.en: Bring assisted walking speed into the safety question.

roundFocus.zh: 在禁車方向下，爭取照顧接送的具體例外。
roundFocus.en: Seek specific care drop-off exceptions within the restriction.

roundFocus.zh: 檢查例外是否真的減少接送壓力。
roundFocus.en: Check whether exceptions actually ease care trips.

barrier.zh: 討論只聚焦校門，忽略完整步行路線
barrier.en: Discussion misses the rest of the walking route

support.zh: 把完整路線帶進走讀與地圖
support.en: Include the whole walking route in the site walk

positive.zh: 討論範圍延伸到實際通勤路線
positive.en: The discussion includes the commuting route

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 希望每天上班的步行路線完整、安全。
motivation.en: Want a safe, continuous daily walk to work.

incentive.zh: 能直接在地圖上補齊被忽略的路段。
incentive.en: Add overlooked links directly on a route map.

desiredOutcome.zh: 改善不只停在校門，而能連到通勤路線。
desiredOutcome.en: Extend improvements from the school gate to the commute.

stageActions.zh: 標出校門外仍不安全的通勤路段。
stageActions.en: Mark unsafe stretches beyond the school gate.

stageActions.zh: 留下可步行踏查的通勤時段。
stageActions.en: Offer commute times for a walking audit.

stageActions.zh: 提醒招募跨街區步行者。
stageActions.en: Include walkers from adjacent neighborhoods.

stageActions.zh: 沿整段路線核對行人設施。
stageActions.en: Check facilities along the entire route.

stageActions.zh: 描述通勤繞路的實際代價。
stageActions.en: Describe the cost of a walking detour.

stageActions.zh: 比較連續步道與局部改善方案。
stageActions.en: Compare a continuous path with isolated fixes.

stageActions.zh: 查核回覆是否處理路線斷點。
stageActions.en: Check whether responses address missing links.

stageActions.zh: 回報新的繞行點與步行時間。
stageActions.en: Report new detours and walking times.

roundFocus.zh: 把通勤路線帶進校門口的議題範圍。
roundFocus.en: Bring the commute into the school-gate problem.

roundFocus.zh: 避免試辦只改善校門前的一小段。
roundFocus.en: Prevent the pilot from fixing only the gate frontage.

roundFocus.zh: 循新動線走一次，記下仍中斷的地方。
roundFocus.en: Walk the new route and note remaining gaps.

barrier.zh: 營業時段無法長時間開會
barrier.en: Business hours make long meetings difficult

support.zh: 保留非同步發言與進貨時段紀錄
support.en: Offer asynchronous input and record delivery times

positive.zh: 進貨需求保留在方案比較裡
positive.en: Delivery needs remain visible in option comparisons

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 學生更安全，店家也能正常收貨、做生意。
motivation.en: Keep students safe while shops can receive goods and trade.

incentive.zh: 營業時不用離店，也能核對涉及店家的文字。
incentive.en: Contribute without closing and review shop-related wording.

desiredOutcome.zh: 有可執行的卸貨安排與試辦回報窗口。
desiredOutcome.en: Get workable loading arrangements and a pilot feedback contact.

stageActions.zh: 把卸貨、客流與安全一起列入範圍。
stageActions.en: Include loading, footfall and safety in scope.

stageActions.zh: 選擇不影響開店的訪談時段。
stageActions.en: Choose an interview outside opening duties.

stageActions.zh: 確認小店與不同業種都被聽見。
stageActions.en: Check representation of small and varied shops.

stageActions.zh: 對照到貨時間與禁車時段。
stageActions.en: Compare delivery times with vehicle restrictions.

stageActions.zh: 具體說明一批貨如何搬進店。
stageActions.en: Explain how a delivery reaches the shop.

stageActions.zh: 比較定時卸貨與定點卸貨的負擔。
stageActions.en: Compare timed loading with designated bays.

stageActions.zh: 核對店家條件是否被誤寫成反對安全。
stageActions.en: Check that shop conditions are not framed as opposing safety.

stageActions.zh: 回報試辦後收貨與生意的變化。
stageActions.en: Report changes to deliveries and trade.

roundFocus.zh: 先讓卸貨經驗成為可討論的限制。
roundFocus.en: Make loading experience a discussable constraint.

roundFocus.zh: 把支持安全與卸貨條件一起寫清楚。
roundFocus.en: State support for safety alongside loading conditions.

roundFocus.zh: 追蹤卸貨例外是否可用，再提修正。
roundFocus.en: Test loading exceptions and propose adjustments.

barrier.zh: 走讀動線與接送空間可能不可近用
barrier.en: The site walk and drop-off may be inaccessible

support.zh: 事先確認無障礙路線並由本人校對摘要
support.en: Check access in advance and invite the speaker to review summaries

positive.zh: 通行例外被明確寫入討論
positive.en: Access exceptions enter the discussion explicitly

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 能自主通行，不必每次都請人抬輪椅。
motivation.en: Travel independently without asking others to lift the wheelchair.

incentive.zh: 現場可到達、可發言，且能校對無障礙需求。
incentive.en: Access the venue, speak and review accessibility needs.

desiredOutcome.zh: 無障礙通路與必要接送例外都有責任人。
desiredOutcome.en: Assign owners for accessible routes and essential drop-offs.

stageActions.zh: 以完整無障礙路徑界定問題。
stageActions.en: Frame the issue around a complete accessible route.

stageActions.zh: 先核對會場坡道、廁所與接送點。
stageActions.en: Check ramps, toilets and drop-off before joining.

stageActions.zh: 指出不能到場的人也需被納入。
stageActions.en: Include people unable to reach the venue.

stageActions.zh: 實測坡度、路緣與通路寬度。
stageActions.en: Inspect slopes, curbs and clear widths.

stageActions.zh: 描述一次被迫繞路或求助的經驗。
stageActions.en: Describe a forced detour or need for assistance.

stageActions.zh: 協商禁車與必要接送如何並存。
stageActions.en: Negotiate restrictions alongside essential access.

stageActions.zh: 檢查回覆有沒有可量測的無障礙承諾。
stageActions.en: Check for measurable accessibility commitments.

stageActions.zh: 沿試辦路線驗證能否獨立通行。
stageActions.en: Verify independent access along the pilot route.

roundFocus.zh: 把無障礙當成安全的一部分。
roundFocus.en: Treat accessibility as part of safety.

roundFocus.zh: 避免禁車方案同時切斷必要的接送。
roundFocus.en: Prevent restrictions from cutting off essential access.

roundFocus.zh: 由實際通行檢查例外與設施是否足夠。
roundFocus.en: Check exceptions and facilities through an access audit.

barrier.zh: 擔心不同意會被當成反對安全
barrier.en: Concern that dissent will be read as opposition to safety

support.zh: 分開記錄安全目標與具體方案異議
support.en: Separate the safety goal from objections to an option

positive.zh: 可以支持目標，同時保留反對理由
positive.en: Support for the goal can coexist with dissent

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 支持安全，也希望住宅生活的顧慮被理解。
motivation.en: Support safety while having residential concerns understood.

incentive.zh: 能保留不同意的理由，不必先選邊站。
incentive.en: Keep reasons for disagreement without choosing a camp.

desiredOutcome.zh: 回覆能區分共同目標與仍有爭議的做法。
desiredOutcome.en: Separate shared goals from disputed measures.

stageActions.zh: 分開寫下安全目標與生活影響。
stageActions.en: Separate safety goals from residential impacts.

stageActions.zh: 確認能用熟悉的方式回覆邀請。
stageActions.en: Reply to the invitation in a familiar format.

stageActions.zh: 留意租戶、長者等較少發言者。
stageActions.en: Look for quieter voices such as tenants and older residents.

stageActions.zh: 對照車流資訊與日常居住經驗。
stageActions.en: Compare traffic evidence with lived experience.

stageActions.zh: 提出疑慮並請主持人確認原意。
stageActions.en: Raise concerns and ask the facilitator to check meaning.

stageActions.zh: 標記可接受與不可接受的條件。
stageActions.en: Mark acceptable and unacceptable conditions.

stageActions.zh: 查核少數意見有沒有被留下。
stageActions.en: Check that minority views remain visible.

stageActions.zh: 根據試辦影響重新表達立場。
stageActions.en: Revisit the position after seeing pilot impacts.

roundFocus.zh: 讓疑慮被聽成條件，而非敵意。
roundFocus.en: Have concerns heard as conditions rather than hostility.

roundFocus.zh: 即使多數支持，也保留尚未解決的反對理由。
roundFocus.en: Keep unresolved objections even with majority support.

roundFocus.zh: 用居住經驗檢查承諾，不急著宣告共識。
roundFocus.en: Check promises against daily life before claiming consensus.

barrier.zh: 工作移動中難以參加固定場次
barrier.en: Mobile work makes fixed sessions difficult

support.zh: 提供短訪與配送時段的補充管道
support.en: Offer short interviews and a way to add delivery schedules

positive.zh: 配送安排成為可比較的條件

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 送貨能準時，也不把風險留給過街的人。
motivation.en: Deliver on time without endangering people crossing.

incentive.zh: 能用短訪談參與，並看到配送條件被保留。
incentive.en: Join a short interview and see delivery conditions retained.

desiredOutcome.zh: 有清楚的停靠時段、位置與搬運距離。
desiredOutcome.en: Get clear stopping times, locations and carrying distances.

stageActions.zh: 把配送動線與過街衝突標在同張圖。
stageActions.en: Map delivery routes and crossing conflicts together.

stageActions.zh: 提供路線中可短暫停留的時段。
stageActions.en: Offer short interview windows along the route.

stageActions.zh: 提醒納入不同班次與車型。
stageActions.en: Include different shifts and vehicle types.

stageActions.zh: 核對卸貨點到目的地的搬運距離。
stageActions.en: Check carrying distances from bays to destinations.

stageActions.zh: 描述臨停背後的時間與工作限制。
stageActions.en: Explain the timing and work constraints behind stopping.

stageActions.zh: 比較替代停靠點能否實際使用。
stageActions.en: Compare the practicality of alternative stops.

stageActions.zh: 確認配送例外不只是模糊承諾。
stageActions.en: Check that delivery exceptions are specific.

stageActions.zh: 回報新動線的延誤與風險。
stageActions.en: Report delays and risks on the new route.

roundFocus.zh: 把臨停問題拆成時段、位置與搬運距離。
roundFocus.en: Break stopping issues into time, location and distance.

roundFocus.zh: 協商能被配送班表採用的安排。
roundFocus.en: Negotiate arrangements that fit delivery schedules.

roundFocus.zh: 用實際路線修正不合用的停靠規則。
roundFocus.en: Use route experience to revise impractical stopping rules.

barrier.zh: 教學與值勤之間沒有足夠討論時間
barrier.en: Teaching and duty leave little discussion time

support.zh: 提供精簡證據包與會後提問
support.en: Offer a short evidence pack and follow-up questions

positive.zh: 責任分工可以被具體檢視

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 讓學生安全進校，也讓值勤安排可負擔。
motivation.en: Keep arrivals safe with manageable staff duties.

incentive.zh: 短時間提供現場證據，後續能看到分工。
incentive.en: Offer brief on-site evidence and see responsibilities assigned.

desiredOutcome.zh: 學校與道路主管機關的任務清楚分開。
desiredOutcome.en: Clarify school and road authority responsibilities.

stageActions.zh: 整理上放學時的衝突位置。
stageActions.en: Identify conflicts at arrival and dismissal.

stageActions.zh: 避開授課與導護時段參與。
stageActions.en: Participate outside teaching and crossing duties.

stageActions.zh: 提醒不同年級的需求不同。
stageActions.en: Highlight differences between age groups.

stageActions.zh: 提供校門觀察並核對資料限制。
stageActions.en: Share gate observations and their limitations.

stageActions.zh: 說明導護人員難以處理的情境。
stageActions.en: Describe situations crossing staff cannot resolve.

stageActions.zh: 檢查方案是否增加不可負擔的值勤。
stageActions.en: Check whether options create unmanageable duties.

stageActions.zh: 逐項核對學校與機關的責任。
stageActions.en: Check each school and agency responsibility.

stageActions.zh: 回收值勤紀錄，調整試辦安排。
stageActions.en: Use duty logs to adjust the pilot.

roundFocus.zh: 讓校門的日常觀察成為共同資料。
roundFocus.en: Make everyday gate observations shared evidence.

roundFocus.zh: 把改善方案對應到明確負責單位。
roundFocus.en: Match improvements to responsible organizations.

roundFocus.zh: 檢查安全改善是否以額外值勤為代價。
roundFocus.en: Check whether safety gains depend on extra staff duties.

barrier.zh: 自行車通行可能在封街討論中被遺漏

support.zh: 要求方案標出自行車與行人的交會點
support.en: Mark cycling and walking conflict points

positive.zh: 自己的通行需求有了來源連結
positive.en: Access needs retain a source link

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 騎車上學或通勤也能安全接近校門。
motivation.en: Reach the school safely by bicycle.

incentive.zh: 能標出自行車與行人的具體衝突點。
incentive.en: Mark specific conflicts between cycles and pedestrians.

desiredOutcome.zh: 方案保留自行車可通行性並降低衝突。
desiredOutcome.en: Preserve cycle access while reducing conflicts.

stageActions.zh: 將自行車接近路線納入議題。
stageActions.en: Include cycling approaches in the scope.

stageActions.zh: 說明騎乘時段與可踏查時間。
stageActions.en: Share riding times and audit availability.

stageActions.zh: 確認學生與通勤騎士都被納入。
stageActions.en: Include student and commuting cyclists.

stageActions.zh: 核對車道、停車架與穿越點。
stageActions.en: Review lanes, cycle parking and crossings.

stageActions.zh: 描述需要下車或繞行的位置。
stageActions.en: Describe forced dismounts and detours.

stageActions.zh: 協商行人優先與自行車通行的界線。
stageActions.en: Negotiate pedestrian priority and cycle access.

stageActions.zh: 追查騎乘需求如何進入回覆。
stageActions.en: Trace cycling needs into the response.

stageActions.zh: 回報試辦後的新衝突或改善。
stageActions.en: Report new conflicts or improvements after the pilot.

roundFocus.zh: 避免議題只剩汽車與行人的二分。
roundFocus.en: Avoid reducing the issue to cars versus pedestrians.

roundFocus.zh: 把自行車通行條件寫進試辦。
roundFocus.en: Write cycling conditions into the pilot.

roundFocus.zh: 觀察新動線是否把衝突移到其他路口。
roundFocus.en: Check whether the new route moves conflicts elsewhere.

barrier.zh: 市場尖峰與活動時間重疊
barrier.en: Market peak hours overlap with meetings

support.zh: 在離峰時段補訪並保留原始用語
support.en: Interview off-peak and retain original wording

positive.zh: 生計需求沒有被摘要抹去

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 市場照常運作，長者和學生也能安全走過。
motivation.en: Keep the market operating with safe passage for older people and students.

incentive.zh: 離峰受訪，能先確認涉及生計的摘要。
incentive.en: Join off-peak and review livelihood-related summaries.

desiredOutcome.zh: 市場運作限制有具體安排，沒有被摘要抹去。
desiredOutcome.en: Retain market constraints and address them concretely.

stageActions.zh: 把市場搬運與步行需求一起畫出。
stageActions.en: Map market handling and pedestrian needs together.

stageActions.zh: 選擇收攤後能專心說明的時段。
stageActions.en: Choose a focused interview after closing.

stageActions.zh: 提醒招募攤商與搬運工作者。
stageActions.en: Include stallholders and handlers.

stageActions.zh: 對照市場尖峰與上學尖峰。
stageActions.en: Compare market and school peak times.

stageActions.zh: 說明一天進貨到收攤的節奏。
stageActions.en: Describe the day from delivery to closing.

stageActions.zh: 討論不讓生計承擔全部成本的做法。
stageActions.en: Discuss options that do not put all costs on livelihoods.

stageActions.zh: 校對摘要是否保留市場限制。
stageActions.en: Check that summaries retain market constraints.

stageActions.zh: 觀察試辦後搬運與步行是否更順。
stageActions.en: Observe handling and walking after the pilot.

roundFocus.zh: 讓早晨市場的工作節奏被理解。
roundFocus.en: Explain the rhythm of the morning market.

roundFocus.zh: 把生計條件轉成可協商的試辦安排。
roundFocus.en: Turn livelihood needs into negotiable pilot conditions.

roundFocus.zh: 回報市場周邊是否出現新的擁塞。
roundFocus.en: Report any new congestion around the market.

barrier.en: Day meetings reduce time for sleep

support.zh: 提供晚間或非同步參與

positive.zh: 不必同時在線也能留下意見
positive.en: A voice can contribute without being online together

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 安全改善不應只照顧白天作息的人。
motivation.en: Safety improvements should also work for people on other schedules.

incentive.zh: 有晚間或非同步入口，不用犧牲睡眠。
incentive.en: Use evening or asynchronous access without losing sleep.

desiredOutcome.zh: 夜班生活的需求在回覆與招募中都有位置。
desiredOutcome.en: Include night-shift needs in responses and recruitment.

stageActions.zh: 指出清晨或夜間不同的安全問題。
stageActions.en: Identify distinct dawn and night-time safety issues.

stageActions.zh: 選擇下班後可回覆的非同步管道。
stageActions.en: Choose an asynchronous channel after work.

stageActions.zh: 檢查固定開會時間排除了誰。
stageActions.en: Check who fixed meeting times exclude.

stageActions.zh: 分段閱讀資料，標出作息落差。
stageActions.en: Read in short sessions and note schedule mismatches.

stageActions.zh: 留下夜班返家的通行經驗。
stageActions.en: Share the journey home from a night shift.

stageActions.zh: 用留言補充錯過現場的條件。
stageActions.en: Add conditions by message after missing a meeting.

stageActions.zh: 確認未到場的意見仍有回覆。
stageActions.en: Check that absent voices still receive responses.

stageActions.zh: 依睡眠與交通變化評估試辦。
stageActions.en: Review the pilot through sleep and travel changes.

roundFocus.zh: 讓未同步到場不等於沒有參與意願。
roundFocus.en: Avoid treating missed meetings as lack of interest.

roundFocus.zh: 保留夜間補充與隔日確認的時間。
roundFocus.en: Leave time for evening input and next-day review.

roundFocus.zh: 檢查試辦是否改善白天卻增加夜班負擔。
roundFocus.en: Check whether daytime gains burden night-shift lives.

barrier.zh: 繞行可能改變候車與轉乘
barrier.en: Diversions may affect waiting and transfers

support.zh: 共同查證站點與替代動線
support.en: Check stops and alternative routes together

positive.zh: 轉乘問題進入共同證據包

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 搭公車接近校門時，轉乘與步行不要更難。
motivation.en: Avoid harder bus transfers and walks near the school.

incentive.zh: 能看懂站位與改道圖，指出多走的路。
incentive.en: Read stop and diversion maps and flag extra walking.

desiredOutcome.zh: 改道決策同時交代站位與轉乘負擔。
desiredOutcome.en: Explain stops and transfer burdens alongside diversions.

stageActions.zh: 把下車到校門的路線納入範圍。
stageActions.en: Include the walk from bus stop to school.

stageActions.zh: 提供常用路線與搭乘時段。
stageActions.en: Share usual routes and travel times.

stageActions.zh: 提醒納入依賴公車的不同乘客。
stageActions.en: Include diverse people who depend on buses.

stageActions.zh: 比對站位、班次與步行距離。
stageActions.en: Compare stops, service times and walking distance.

stageActions.zh: 說明一次轉乘如何受改道影響。
stageActions.en: Explain how a diversion affects a transfer.

stageActions.zh: 討論站位調整與行人安全的取捨。
stageActions.en: Discuss trade-offs between stop changes and pedestrian safety.

stageActions.zh: 確認回覆交代替代路線與資訊。
stageActions.en: Check that responses explain alternatives and information.

stageActions.zh: 試走新站位到目的地的路線。
stageActions.en: Try the walk from new stops to destinations.

roundFocus.zh: 讓公車使用者的最後一段路被看見。
roundFocus.en: Make the bus rider’s last walking segment visible.

roundFocus.zh: 把轉乘成本放進試辦比較。
roundFocus.en: Include transfer costs in the pilot comparison.

roundFocus.zh: 回報新站位的可達性與資訊落差。
roundFocus.en: Report stop accessibility and information gaps.

barrier.zh: 兒童安全與接送便利需要同時考慮
barrier.en: Child safety and drop-off access both matter

support.zh: 把親子走讀與不同接送情境納入
support.en: Include family walks and different drop-off situations

positive.zh: 方案開始說清楚安全與通行取捨
positive.en: Options make safety and access trade-offs explicit

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 孩子能安全到校，家庭接送也有可行安排。
motivation.en: Get children to school safely with workable family trips.

incentive.zh: 能以家庭路線說明，而非被歸為支持或反對禁車。
incentive.en: Explain a family route instead of being labeled for or against restrictions.

desiredOutcome.zh: 接送取捨與兒童安全都寫進條件。
desiredOutcome.en: Include both drop-off trade-offs and child safety in conditions.

stageActions.zh: 把孩子從家到校的整段旅程畫出。
stageActions.en: Map the child’s full journey from home to school.

stageActions.zh: 提供上班與接送之間的參與空檔。
stageActions.en: Offer time between work and school trips.

stageActions.zh: 提醒不同照顧安排的家庭都需被聽見。
stageActions.en: Include families with different care arrangements.

stageActions.zh: 與孩子觀察路口，分開記錄看法。
stageActions.en: Observe crossings with children and distinguish their views.

stageActions.zh: 說明接送選擇背後的限制。
stageActions.en: Explain constraints behind drop-off choices.

stageActions.zh: 比較步行、接駁與臨停安排。
stageActions.en: Compare walking, shuttle and drop-off arrangements.

stageActions.zh: 確認安全承諾與家庭條件都有回覆。
stageActions.en: Check responses to safety promises and family needs.

stageActions.zh: 記錄試辦後接送是否更安心。
stageActions.en: Record whether school trips feel safer during the pilot.

roundFocus.zh: 讓安全與接送的雙重需求同時被理解。
roundFocus.en: Explain both safety and family travel needs.

roundFocus.zh: 把家庭路線轉成方案的具體條件。
roundFocus.en: Turn family routes into concrete conditions for options.

roundFocus.zh: 用接送紀錄檢查條件是否可行。
roundFocus.en: Use trip notes to check the conditions work.

barrier.zh: 第一輪邀請沒有涵蓋到宅照顧工作

support.zh: 補邀並詢問服務時間與通行限制
support.en: Invite follow-up input on service times and access

positive.zh: 下一輪重新打開了參與入口

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 服務對象能被照顧，工作路線不因禁車而中斷。
motivation.en: Keep care visits possible when vehicle access changes.

incentive.zh: 收到補邀請，並能針對服務時段提出例外。
incentive.en: Receive a follow-up invitation and propose service-hour exceptions.

desiredOutcome.zh: 必要到宅服務有可查核的通行安排。
desiredOutcome.en: Provide verifiable access arrangements for essential home care.

stageActions.zh: 補充原議題未涵蓋的到宅服務需求。
stageActions.en: Add home-care needs missing from the original scope.

stageActions.zh: 回覆補邀請並說明服務路線。
stageActions.en: Respond to follow-up recruitment with service routes.

stageActions.zh: 協助辨識還未被邀請的照顧工作者。
stageActions.en: Identify care workers still missing from recruitment.

stageActions.zh: 核對禁車時段與服務班表。
stageActions.en: Compare restriction times with visit schedules.

stageActions.zh: 說明一次訪視的時間與設備需求。
stageActions.en: Explain the timing and equipment for a care visit.

stageActions.zh: 提出有條件的服務通行安排。
stageActions.en: Propose conditional access for care visits.

stageActions.zh: 確認必要服務例外有聯絡窗口。
stageActions.en: Check for a contact handling essential-service exceptions.

stageActions.zh: 回報通行安排是否維持照顧連續性。
stageActions.en: Report whether access arrangements preserve continuity of care.

roundFocus.zh: 首輪尚未被納入；主持人要辨識到宅照顧的缺席。
roundFocus.en: Not included in round one; facilitators need to identify missing home-care voices.

roundFocus.zh: 補邀請後，把服務路線帶進試辦條件。
roundFocus.en: After follow-up recruitment, bring service routes into pilot conditions.

roundFocus.zh: 檢查服務例外能否避免照顧中斷。
roundFocus.en: Check whether service exceptions prevent interrupted care.

barrier.zh: 校門改善可能把負擔轉到巷弄
barrier.en: Improvements may shift the burden to side streets

support.zh: 補做巷弄走讀，追蹤外溢影響
support.en: Walk side streets and track spillover

positive.zh: 後續回饋仍能修正試辦範圍
positive.en: Later feedback can revise the pilot scope

need.zh: 確認意見如何被回覆，並保留修正入口
need.en: See how the voice is answered and keep a correction route

motivation.zh: 校門更安全，也不把車流負擔轉進自家巷弄。
motivation.en: Improve school-gate safety without shifting traffic into residential lanes.

incentive.zh: 有側街踏查與回報入口，能要求修正試辦。
incentive.en: Use side-street audits and feedback to request pilot revisions.

desiredOutcome.zh: 分流負擔有監測，受影響巷弄有回應。
desiredOutcome.en: Monitor diverted traffic and respond to affected lanes.

stageActions.zh: 補畫可能承接分流車輛的巷弄。
stageActions.en: Map lanes likely to receive diverted vehicles.

stageActions.zh: 回覆補邀請並標出受影響住戶。
stageActions.en: Reply to follow-up recruitment and identify affected homes.

stageActions.zh: 檢查分流路段居民是否被納入。
stageActions.en: Check representation along diversion routes.

stageActions.zh: 比較試辦前後巷內車流。
stageActions.en: Compare lane traffic before and during the pilot.

stageActions.zh: 描述巷內會車與生活受到的影響。
stageActions.en: Describe passing conflicts and daily-life impacts in the lane.

stageActions.zh: 討論避免風險轉移的修正條件。
stageActions.en: Discuss conditions preventing risk displacement.

stageActions.zh: 要求回覆交代分流監測與改善責任。
stageActions.en: Seek a response assigning diversion monitoring and mitigation.

stageActions.zh: 回報試辦外溢，推動下一輪調整。
stageActions.en: Report spillover and seek next-round adjustments.

roundFocus.zh: 首輪尚未被納入；分流巷弄的經驗仍是缺口。
roundFocus.en: Not included in round one; diversion-lane experience remains a gap.

roundFocus.zh: 補邀請後，讓外溢車流成為試辦的檢查條件。
roundFocus.en: After follow-up recruitment, make spillover a pilot check.

roundFocus.zh: 以巷內回報推動修正，避免風險只是搬家。
roundFocus.en: Use lane feedback to revise the pilot rather than relocate risk.

description.zh: 插畫、動機與旅程提示是編寫的虛構情境；出席與資料成果由 flow-demo.json 決定。
description.en: Illustrations, motivations and journey prompts are authored fiction. Attendance and evidence come from flow-demo.json.
